bil-01: tridalaṃ triguṇākāraṃ trinetraṃ ca triyāyudham | trijanmapāpasaṃhāraṃ ekabilvaṃ śivārpaṇam ||
bil-02: triśākhaiḥ bilvapatraiśca hyacchidraiḥ komalaiḥ śubhaiḥ | śivapūjāṃ kariṣyāmi ekabilvaṃ śivārpaṇam ||
bil-03: akhaṇḍabilvapatreṇa pūjite nandikeśvare | śuddhyanti sarvapāpebhyo ekabilvaṃ śivārpaṇam ||
bil-04: śālagrāmaśilāmekāṃ viprāṇāṃ jātu cārpayet | somayajñamahāpuṇyaṃ ekabilvaṃ śivārpaṇam ||
bil-05: dantikotisahasrāṇi aśvamedhaśatāni ca | koṭikanyāmahādānaṃ ekabilvaṃ śivārpaṇam ||
bil-06: lakṣmyāḥ stanuta utpannaṃ mahādevasya ca priyam | bilvavṛkṣaṃ prayacchāmi ekabilvaṃ śivārpaṇam ||
bil-07: darśanaṃ bilvavṛkṣasya sparśanaṃ pāpanāśanam | aghorapāpasaṃhāraṃ ekabilvaṃ śivārpaṇam ||
bil-08: mūlato brahmarūpāya madhyato viṣṇurūpiṇe | agrataḥ śivarūpāya ekabilvaṃ śivārpaṇam ||
bil-09: bilvāṣṭakamidaṃ puṇyaṃ yaḥ paṭhecchivasannidhau | śivalokamavāpnoti śivena saha modate ||
